Professional.title: Professional Experience
Professional.GoodsoftwaredevDescription:
Since 2022, I’ve been part of the development team at GoodSoftwareDev, working on the design, development, and maintenance of modern, scalable user interfaces using technologies such as JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, React.js, Tailwind CSS, and NodeJS.



My work primarily focuses on building interactive dashboards, SEO-optimized landing pages, and highly reusable component libraries that ensure both performance and accessibility. I collaborate closely with UI/UX designers to translate design systems into pixel-perfect, responsive layouts, and with backend engineers to integrate frontend features seamlessly with RESTful APIs.



Throughout this experience, I’ve gained strong proficiency in development and collaboration tools such as Git, Figma, Notion, and Postman, while contributing to continuous integration and deployment workflows.



Working in a fully remote, agile environment has also strengthened my communication, teamwork, and time management skills. I’ve learned to coordinate effectively with distributed teams across multiple time zones, participate actively in code reviews, and deliver high-quality features within sprint cycles. I always strive to deliver clean, maintainable, and scalable code, with a strong focus on quality, performance, and client satisfaction.



This role has not only enhanced my technical skills but also helped me grow professionally in remote work environments. I’ve gained significant experience working asynchronously with international teams, participating in code reviews, and contributing to shared goals across different time zones.

ghs.description: A web app for Grapevine High School to manage football players’ profiles and track their college offers in an organized and accessible way.
ghs.longDescription: This web application was developed for a school to manage and showcase its football players and their college offers. Coaches and staff can easily add, update, and view player profiles, including personal information, athletic stats, highlight videos, and academic achievements. The platform also tracks college offers received by each player, providing a clear and organized view of their recruitment progress. This tool enhances visibility for student-athletes and simplifies communication between the school and interested universities.

rocketbooking.description: Users can create and manage targeted SMS and email campaigns to promote their services through an intuitive and centralized platform designed for effective outreach.
rocketbooking.longDescription: This web application allows users to create and manage personalized SMS and email marketing campaigns targeted to their contact lists. Designed to help small businesses and professionals promote their services, the platform offers easy-to-use tools for composing messages, scheduling delivery, and tracking engagement, all in one place.

homeplate.description: Each user can design and customize their own personal page with content, styles, and layouts that reflect their identity, making it easy to share who they are in a unique and professional way.
homeplate.longDescription: This project allows users to create and personalize their own individual web pages, tailoring content, colors, fonts, and layout to suit their preferences. The platform provides a simple and intuitive interface for editing, so users can express their personal brand or online identity without needing technical skills.

microverse.shortDescription: Intensive remote software development program focused on full-stack web development with JavaScript, React, and Ruby on Rails.
microverse.fullDescription:
In 2022, I joined Microverse, an intensive, full-time remote software development program where I dedicated over 1300 hours to mastering full-stack web development. The curriculum focused heavily on JavaScript, React, Redux, and Ruby on Rails, with a strong emphasis on algorithms, data structures, and building scalable applications through project-based learning.



Through daily remote pair programming sessions and weekly team projects, I gained hands-on experience collaborating with developers from all over the world, simulating real-world agile environments. I practiced industry-standard Git workflows, conducted code reviews, and participated in daily stand-ups to ensure transparent, async communication.



Beyond technical development, I also mentored junior developers, supporting them in understanding React best practices, testing methodologies, and debugging strategies. This experience deepened my leadership and communication skills, while reinforcing my commitment to writing clean, maintainable, and scalable code.



Microverse prepared me not only as a developer but as a remote professional, ready to thrive in globally distributed teams and continuously adapt to new challenges in fast-paced environments.

university.degree: Elechtromechanical Engineering (incomplete) - National University of Mar del Plata, Argentina
university.shortDescription: Coursework in mathematics, physics, and engineering fundamentals before transitioning to a career in software development.
university.fullDescription:
During my time studying Electromechanical Engineering, I developed a strong foundation in problem-solving, analytical thinking, and applied mathematics. The program’s rigorous focus on physics, mechanics, and systems design helped me build a methodical approach to tackling complex technical challenges.



While working on various engineering projects, I discovered a passion for software and automation — realizing how code could extend the capabilities of physical systems and streamline workflows.



This growing interest led me to transition into software development, where I could combine my analytical mindset with creativity to design efficient and scalable digital solutions.

highschool.degree: Electromechanical Technician - E.E.S.T. N°3, Mar del Plata, Argentina
highschool.shortDescription: Graduated with a focus on science and mathematics, laying a strong foundation for analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
highschool.fullDescription:
My high school education in Electromechanics introduced me to the world of technology and systems thinking. I spent much of my time understanding how machines worked, learning to analyze, assemble, and maintain mechanical and electrical components.



What began as curiosity about how things function evolved into a passion for creating new solutions, which ultimately led me toward programming and software development.



This foundation helped me build the discipline, patience, and analytical mindset that I continue to apply in my work as a developer.
